userStories.title: User turns preserved verbatim
acceptanceCriteria: Every user turn in the input transcript appears character-for-character in the compressed output
Ordering of user turns is preserved

userStories.title: Assistant turns truncated with summary marker
acceptanceCriteria: Assistant turns longer than 200 chars are replaced with the first 200 chars followed by `...[+N more chars, M tool calls]`
N is the count of additional characters, M is the count of tool calls in that assistant turn
Assistant turns of 200 chars or fewer are preserved verbatim

userStories.title: Tool results dropped, tool calls trimmed
acceptanceCriteria: Tool-result blocks are absent from the compressed output
Tool-call entries appear as `name(args)` where args is truncated to the first 80 characters
On a recorded 50-turn fixture the compressed length is at most 30% of the original
